title: Why Choosing Premium Mulch Protects Plants Through Chicago Winters
intro: Chicago homeowners know the unique challenges our city's climate presents to a thriving landscape. From the biting winds off Lake Michigan to dramatic freeze-thaw cycles and heavy snowfalls, our plants endure a gauntlet of environmental stressors each year. While many focus on spring planting and summer watering, the secret weapon for year-round plant health and garden resilience lies in a often-underestimated hero: premium hardwood mulch. More than just a decorative top layer, the right mulch, expertly applied, acts as a critical shield, nutrient source, and aesthetic enhancer, especially when facing the brunt of a Chicago winter. This guide delves into why investing in professional premium hardwood mulch delivery and installation is not just a luxury, but a vital strategy for protecting your green investment and ensuring a vibrant landscape for seasons to come.
